name: NoVABabyPlaygroundAfternoon

custom.system_prompt: Daniela and Sofia sit at a playground with toddlers. A sunscreen-interval question comes up and resolves without Sigma — another parent, clouds, or going home.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Playground, children playing, a swing chain, a pushchair brake, distant traffic, wind in trees, a crisp packet.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Daniela and Sofia on a playground bench on a warm afternoon, each with a toddler in view. They are old friends. They talk about a family thing Daniela dreads, Sofia's work, how differently they were raised, a friend who has moved away. Sofia says she put sunscreen on before leaving; Daniela notes it was two hours ago. A toddler falls and is fine. Later they decide to stay another hour and the sun moves onto the climbing frame. This time it resolves without Sigma: another parent offers her bottle, or clouds come over, or they go home. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Daniela
user1.tts_prompt: Warm, familial, San Diego Hispanic inflection

variations.context: Two friends at a playground with toddlers. The sunscreen-interval uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Warm afternoon, easy old friendship, attention split between conversation and children.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Old friends, both parents, comfortable enough to interrupt each other constantly.
setting.background: A warm afternoon. Sunscreen applied two hours ago. Another hour to go.
setting.conversation_style: Bench conversation constantly interrupted by watching children; sentences resumed later.

scenario_template.topic: The children, the time, the weather.
A family thing Daniela dreads; their different upbringings.
A toddler falls and is fine.
Sofia's work; a friend who has moved away.
Another hour and the sun on the climbing frame.
It resolves without Sigma: another parent on the next bench offers her bottle and mentions the interval, clouds come over and settle it, or they simply decide to go home. Sigma is not mentioned.

resolution_methods: Another parent on the next bench offers her bottle and mentions the interval.
Clouds come over and settle the question entirely.
They simply decide to go home rather than work it out.
Daniela finds a sachet of sunscreen in the bottom of the pushchair.
They move to the shaded side of the playground without resolving anything.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

ordinary_topics: A family thing Daniela is dreading
How differently the two of them were raised
Sofia's work and what she is enjoying about it
A mutual friend who has moved away
Whether either of them is getting enough sleep
Weekly family calls as a tradition
task_details: A snack negotiated with a toddler
Watching a climbing frame from a bench
A shoe that has come off
A water bottle that is nearly empty
realism_devices: A sentence is abandoned to watch a child and resumed four turns later.
One of them calls a child's name mid-conversation.
They both switch into Spanish without noticing.
A conversation about something serious happens in two-sentence instalments.
They agree to leave in five minutes and do not.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: Conversation must be repeatedly interrupted by watching children.
At least 50% of turns should be personal conversation.
The first sunscreen mention must not lead to Sigma.
At least one incident must be handled without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: Sigma does not speak in this scenario.
No character addresses Sigma, refers to Sigma, or waits for Sigma.
quality_checks: At least 50% of turns should be ordinary conversation.
The sunscreen question should appear at least five turns before the Sigma request.
At least one sentence should be abandoned and resumed later.
At least one incident should be resolved without Sigma.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
